title.en: Pinjin Equipment Ships from Xingtai, with No Overseas Warehouse Claim
title.zh: 品锦设备从邢台发货，不声称海外仓

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery states that listed machines are made in Xingtai and ship from Xingtai. The site does not claim an overseas warehouse or a global after-sales network.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械写明所列机器在邢台制造，并从邢台发货。本站不声称有海外仓或全球售后网络。

h1.en: Plan the Purchase as a Shipment from Xingtai
h1.zh: 按从邢台发货来安排采购

directAnswer.en: A purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery is a shipment from Xingtai, Hebei. The category pages say there is no overseas warehouse, no exclusive-distributor claim and no global after-sales network on this site. Inquire by the contact page, WhatsApp, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Send the model path, weight and dimensions from that path, destination country and purchase timing. Do not write a local stock location the catalogue does not have.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械采购，就是从河北邢台发货。分类页写明本站没有海外仓、不声称独家经销网、也没有全球售后网络。通过询盘页、WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025 联系。发送该路径上的型号、重量和外形、目的国家与采购时间。不要写目录里没有的本地库存地点。

body.en: The manufacturer line is Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai, Hebei, China. That is the place the pages name. It is not a warehouse address in another country.
body.zh: 制造商一行是河北品锦机械制造有限公司，中国河北省邢台市任泽工业园区。这是页面点名的地点。它不是另一个国家的仓库地址。

heading.en: Weight still comes from the model page

body.en: A Xingtai shipment of Electric 15 is the 450 kg frame. A shipment of Diesel 120 is the 8000 kg frame. The origin does not make those weights interchangeable.
body.zh: 从邢台发出的电动15是 450 kg 的机架。柴油120是 8000 kg 的机架。产地不会让这些重量互换。

body.en: Ask [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) to confirm price and whatever transport answer the factory will give. This page adds no tariff.
body.zh: 请 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 确认价格以及工厂愿意给出的运输答复。本篇不加运价。

answer.en: Yes. The category answer says Hebei Pinjin Machinery manufactures the listed models in Xingtai, Hebei, China.
answer.zh: 是。分类问答写明河北品锦机械在中国河北邢台制造目录所列机型。

question.en: Can I collect from an overseas depot?
question.zh: 可以从海外仓库提货吗？

answer.en: The site says no overseas warehouse is claimed.
answer.zh: 本站写明不声称拥有海外仓。

question.en: Is there a published service network abroad?
question.zh: 有公布的境外服务网吗？

answer.en: The site says it does not claim a global after-sales network.
answer.zh: 本站写明不声称拥有全球售后网络。

alt.en: Dispatch from the Hebei Pinjin Machinery factory, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 河北品锦机械厂家发货现场，邢台混凝土泵厂家
